main_findings: All six completed fresh worlds have the exact same five failed lanes, final script phases, 8.0 s terminal clock, failure code 6 and no BLEND/RL entry. Each world ended 16 fallen episodes with 11 complete and five script timeouts.

This gap occurs under exclusive native script control before PPO ownership. Continued actor learning alone does not directly control these five failed prefixes; the native script-to-RL chain needs diagnosis and physical validation.

Recorded condition failures are evidence of incomplete physical/sensor preparation, not proof of an impossible implementation guard or a unique training cause. Unlogged joint target errors, feedback and torque history prevent a narrower drive/geometry causal claim.

native_clock_and_completion_semantics.clock_source: RecoveryTraining.failed uses elapsed from reset, including passive release; RecoveryFSM.age starts when finite release ends. Diagnostics report min(elapsed, initial_release + FSM age * .005). The wrapper reaches 8 s before the inner FSM 8 s script-age budget, retaining CAPTURE/PREPARE phase and substituting failure_code 6.

SIDE.converted_condition: elapsed > .05 and abs(gravity_y) < .65; select upright PREPARE or new FOLD route

other_route_guards.FOLD_complete: remaining < .02, paired measured error < .2, phase elapsed >= .3
other_route_guards.PLANT_complete: remaining < .15, paired measured error < .2, support dwell >= .06; phase timeout 2.5 s
other_route_guards.ORBIT_to_THRUST: sensor support, tilt < 145 deg, FK height > .12, orbit angle > 3.7 rad
other_route_guards.ORBIT_to_CAPTURE: tilt < 30 deg, FK height > .22, sensor support
other_route_guards.THRUST_to_CAPTURE: tilt < 65 deg, FK height > .24, gyro norm < 8, sensor support
other_route_guards.script_reroute: CAPTURE/PREPARE, unsupported and tilt >70 deg for .15 s, at most one reroute; budget/winding/target/drive history preserved

script_reference_goal.formula: aligned_goal = nominal + clamp((tilt - 12 deg)/43 deg, 0, 1)*(support - nominal) - pitch/axis_signs; paired_delta for ordinary aligned goals; one common fraction advances four roots

wheel_control.target_formula: target = (8*pitch + 1.5*gyro_y)*wheel_axis_sign/kd + (1 - .2/kd)*wheel_dq; only when released, supported, CAPTURE/PREPARE or newly BLEND, tilt below 85/55 deg
wheel_control.request_formula: wheel_request = kd*(target - wheel_dq) + support_probe_torque; clamp to native current bound, then phase-aware transport/actuator response and envelope clipping

observer_geometry_and_support.FK_height: minimum of separate encoder-FK wheel-grounded height candidates, not physical root height
observer_geometry_and_support.support_plausible: valid grounded-height candidates, minimum > .12 m, left/right height difference < .035 m, IMU specific-force norm in (6,16), gyro norm < 8
observer_geometry_and_support.body_clear: (wheel response probe confirmed or native BLEND/RL) AND support plausible AND minimum FK height > .27 m
observer_geometry_and_support.probe: alternating +/- .18 Nm wheel pulses; loaded response requires abs wheel acceleration <100 rad/s^2 and gyro angular acceleration <90 rad/s^2 while pulse >=.14; all four side/sign evidence ages <.6 s; clear after .05 s lost plausibility

evidence_limits_and_implementation_confl.trace_sampling: Every tenth policy tick at .02+n*.2 s plus actual native terminal event samples; not the complete 200 Hz feedback stream. Phase changes are first observed times and may be delayed until the next sampled row.
evidence_limits_and_implementation_confl.mixed_sample_timing: FSM condition masks persist from the final reference update before the last 5 ms integration; physical omega/gravity/root height are read after all four integrations. They are not synchronous at a row timestamp, even with USB/signal delay disabled.
evidence_limits_and_implementation_confl.native_diagnostics_have_some_omitted_fie: env and RecoveryTraining diagnostics already expose motor_position/velocity/effort/gap and recovery_observed_height/continuous_q/leg_target_error/wheel_balance_active/velocity_target, but this driver retains only aggregate metrics and selected trace fields.
known_native_source_semantics_not_confli: 8 s budget includes finite passive release
wrapper timeout preserves inner script phase
nominal/support are both static PD-corrected, so extension difference is zero
pre-step masks and post-step physical diagnostic vectors have different sample instants

next_validation_recommendation_only_not_.path: Re-use the authenticated native side-start -> finite passive release -> original script -> PREPARE -> BLEND -> pure RL -> continuous stable gate -> original followup chain. Preserve the script and native timing while measuring the failed gate.
next_validation_recommendation_only_not_.feedback_to_retain_on_future_authorized_: At every existing 200 Hz reference, record timestamp, physical/pre-feedback sample identity, phase/route/age/elapsed, continuous q/dq, target/paired remaining and error/ready ticks, FK height and probe histories, wheel target/balance, requested/bounded/transported/applied torques and bounds, true contacts/closure/passive knee/spring geometry; retain native 50 Hz ended events and policy masks.
